description: Boot the selected device when needed, then open an app, deep link, or URL in a session. Use the app or URL inputs to choose what becomes the foreground automation target. Remote daemons refuse file: URLs in open targets and launch URLs with reason REMOTE_HOST_INPUT_DENIED. Serve local web content over HTTP(S) instead. metroHost, metroPort, and bundleUrl choose the app's Metro server and save its address for later reloads. launchUrl selects the app's launch URL and does not select the reload server. A fresh open without Metro hints clears an older same-name binding; close also clears it. Times out after 90s; a caller-supplied budget extends it.

app.description: App name, bundle id, package, or URL.

bundleUrl.description: Session-scoped bundle URL hint applied to the opened app.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

deviceBaseline.description: Proxy lease: saved device state (baseline) to restore on the leased device. Honored only by a proxy backend that leases by spec; other daemons refuse it.

deviceMode.description: Proxy lease: iOS simulator mode, slim or full. Honored only by a proxy backend that leases by spec; other daemons refuse it.

force.description: Overwrite an existing --save-script target instead of refusing (alias: --overwrite).

foreground.description: Include an initial interactive snapshot in a fresh open response. With no app argument, discover the sole running app on the sole booted iOS simulator; ambiguous environments fail closed.

imageTag.description: Proxy lease: Android system image tag, for example google_apis_playstore. Honored only by a proxy backend that leases by spec; other daemons refuse it.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

launchArgs.description: Launch arguments forwarded verbatim to the platform launch command.

launchConsole.description: File path on the daemon host for the stdout and stderr of the initial app launch. Local or Limrun iOS simulator direct app launches only; not for URL opens.

launchUrl.description: Launch URL for the opened app; does not select the server used by metro reload.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

metroHost.description: Session-scoped Metro/debug host hint applied to the opened app.

metroPort.description: Session-scoped Metro/debug port hint applied to the opened app. Without metroHost, emulators and simulators use the loopback alias; physical devices need metroHost.

osVersion.description: Proxy lease: OS version or range, for example 18.6.2 or ">=26" (Android: API level). Honored only by a proxy backend that leases by spec; other daemons refuse it.

physical.description: Proxy lease: true requests a physical device; false selects nothing. Honored only by a proxy backend that leases by spec; other daemons refuse it.

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

surface.description: macOS presentation surface to open: the app itself, the frontmost app, the desktop, or the menu bar.

testIme.description: Activate the headless Android test IME for deterministic Unicode text entry (default on for emulators; opt-in on real devices).

timeoutMs.description: Startup budget in milliseconds. Bounds the Simulator boot wait, so a never-booted Simulator can finish its first-boot migration; omit for the default startup behavior.

url.description: Optional URL passed with an app shell.

waitMs.description: Wait up to n milliseconds (100-120000) while another session holds the device, then fail with DEVICE_IN_USE. A claim held by another workspace fails at once. The wait extends this command's timeout.

name: open
